symptom: Ciena on Workday, 30 September: the agent filled a degree's From 2015 and To 2019 from the profile, then logged "corrected 'Year' in 'Bachelor of Science ..., JNTU' from '2019' to 'empty'" -- the right To year was wiped, and the page was refused again.
site: Workday (date parts labelled only 'Month' / 'Year'); any entry box whose label does not name its field
root_cause: _correct_entries emptied any optional entry box the agent had written when repeated_entries.answer returned no value; but answer returns no value both when the record says the box is empty and when the label ('Year') names no field it knows -- so an unknown was corrected to empty.
why_tests_missed: The correction tests used labels that name their field ('Start date', 'To year').
fix: repeated_entries.understands(entry) says whether the record can tell what a box holds; _correct_entries empties an agent-written optional box only when it can, and otherwise keeps what was written.
prevention: Every 'no value' result distinguishes 'known to be empty' from 'unknown'; a correction that removes an answer requires the former.
